candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E dey get diarrhoea for 3 days. E no dey convulse now, and dem no talk say e don convulse before. E no dey lethargic and e dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. E stool no get blood inside. E dey drink normally. E no dey restless or irritable. If I pinch e skin, e skin return normal. E eye no dey sunken. E no get cough or any wahala to breathe. E no get ear problem. E no get fever.
